horizontal_crs: Geographic decimal degrees; datum not specified in retrieved GHCN station listing
sampling: Daily accumulation; date is source reporting-date label
timestamp_notes: Observation hour and accumulation boundaries not established. Do not equate printed date to midnight local, UTC day, or PRISM interval.
quality_notes: Raw missing sentinel -9999 becomes empty numeric cell. Blank QFLAG passes source checks. T is trace (numeric zero retained with trace flag); P is missing presumed zero, excluded from usable records. All measurement, quality and source flags retained.
